FORSALE.intro: Let potential buyers know this domain name is for sale. Add as much or as little detail as you want.

wrong-owner-name.title: For-sale record published at "{{name}}" instead of _for-sale
wrong-owner-name.detail: RFC 10023 requires these TXT records to sit at a _for-sale leaf node.

missing-version.title: Missing v=FORSALE1; prefix
missing-version.detail: Every _for-sale TXT record must begin with v=FORSALE1;. Records without it are ignored.

malformed-content.title: "{{content}}" is not a tag-value pair
malformed-content.detail: After the version tag, a record holds either nothing or a single tag=value pair.

multiple-pairs.title: More than one pair in the {{tag}} record
multiple-pairs.detail: A _for-sale TXT record must not carry more than one tag-value pair. Split them into separate records.

duplicate-pair.title: Duplicated pair "{{pair}}"
duplicate-pair.detail: Every tag-value pair of the RRset must be unique. The same tag may repeat, but only with a different value.

unknown-tag.title: Unknown tag "{{tag}}"
unknown-tag.detail: This tag is not defined by RFC 10023. It is published as it is, and consumers will ignore it.

empty-value.title: Empty value for {{tag}}
empty-value.detail: Remove the entry or fill it in: a tag published without a value carries no information.

value-too-long.title: The {{tag}} value is {{length}} octets long
value-too-long.detail: RFC 10023 limits fcod and ftxt values to {{max}} octets.

invalid-price.title: "{{value}}" is not a valid price
invalid-price.detail: A price is a currency code in capital letters followed by an amount, e.g. USD750 or EUR1234.56.

invalid-uri.title: "{{uri}}" is not a valid URI
invalid-uri.detail: The contact link must be an absolute URI, e.g. https://example.com/for-sale or mailto:sales@example.com.

unusual-uri-scheme.title: Unusual URI scheme "{{scheme}}"
unusual-uri-scheme.detail: RFC 10023 recommends http, https, mailto or tel, so that a human can act on {{uri}}.

ttl-too-high.title: The TTL of {{ttl}} seconds is above the recommended hour
ttl-too-high.detail: RFC 10023 recommends a TTL of 3600 seconds or less, so the announcement can be withdrawn quickly once the domain is sold.

inconsistent-ttl.title: The _for-sale records do not share the same TTL ({{ttls}})
inconsistent-ttl.detail: All the records of the RRset should carry the same TTL.

no-content.title: The domain is announced for sale without any detail
no-content.detail: Add an asking price, a message, a contact link or a broker code, so that a buyer knows how to reach you.
